subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, given the new authenticated browser microphone-audio RPC?
rationale: Code review can assess the implementation, but accepting browser-captured audio through Gateway STT providers is a product and security-boundary choice that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue after proof and fixes
options.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the accessibility and docs-map defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the linked feature issue
options.body: Keep the paired feature issue and this PR open while maintainers decide the Control UI dictation boundary and ownership.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: If maintainers do not want core dictation now or prefer a fresh implementation, close this PR and route future work through the paired issue or a new narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and fixes
recommendation.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the accessibility and docs-map defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.
